digest.component_or_area: ticket summary generation and agent guidance
propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but discards the resolved alias from output, returning only the caller-supplied ticket identifier
agent guidance lacks affirmative selection rules specifying when to use aliases versus canonical UUIDs, leading agents to copy locally salient four-character prefixes
schema and library/MCP/CLI contracts institutionalize an alias-free summary shape, making the short prefix the most discoverable identifier
pinned behavioral evaluation demonstrates that adding the resolved alias to summary output produces 25/25 alias selections by agents, while alias-omission produces 25/25 prefix selections
the fix adds the exact resolved alias as an additive field to summary results while preserving ticket_id echo semantics and fail-closed ambiguous-prefix behavior
agent guidance must affirmatively direct aliases for tracker commands and canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts like rebar-ticket trailers
